facts.fact: The World Bank says a law passed on 28 May 2026 allows births to be registered en masse within the mass biometric enrolment operation (PRODIGY).
The World Bank says PRODIGY had enrolled over 3.25 million adults by 10 June 2026, about 10% of the 32.7 million population (computed from the population given).

MDG.note: Enrolment is of adults and issues birth certificates; no number at birth is stated.
Financing by the World Bank is stated; operation and ownership are not.
No register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: The World Bank says nationwide biometric enrolment under PRODIGY began in April 2026 with over 2,000 teams and had enrolled over 3.25 million adults by 10 June.
The World Bank says teams collect fingerprints and iris scans, and identity is confirmed against a de-duplicated biometric database.
